panes.title: 06-recursion
panes.source:
(load-lain
  "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/semantic_traversal.lain")

; sum-to(4, 0) = 10
; (4,0) -> (3,4) -> (2,7) -> (1,9) -> (0,10)
(define sum-to
  (network [n acc]
    ((if (<= n 0)
       (network [n acc]
         acc)
       (network [n acc]
         (sum-to (- n 1) (+ acc n))))
     n acc)))

(define input 4)
(def-cells result)

(-> (sum-to input 0) result)

(display
  (observe-dependents-retained input))

panes.title: 07-two-outputs
panes.source:
(load-lain
  "propagators/compiler_2/runtime/lain/semantic_traversal.lain")

; two outputs: sum = 7, product = 12, result = 19
(define stats
  (network [x y sum product]
    (-> (+ x y) sum)
    (-> (* x y) product)
    (list sum product)))

(def-cells sum product result)

(stats 3 4 sum product)
(-> (+ sum product) result)

(display
  (observe-dependents-retained sum))
